description: Live intelligence for ONE North American phone number: current carrier of record, line type, LRN routing data, porting activation date, and optionally caller-ID name (cnam), spam reputation, and messaging provider. Always a fresh read of live numbering infrastructure — never cached carrier data.
name: vri_number_lookup

data.description: Carrier, line type, LRN, and any requested cnam/spam/messaging fields

risk.description: Explainable spam/risk verdict: WHY the number is flagged (or not), with an honest confidence band. A clean verdict means "nothing found against it", never "verified safe".

confidence.description: How much weight the evidence actually carries

confidence_note.description: One plain sentence explaining the band

reasons.description: Individual pieces of evidence behind the verdict

code.description: provider_flag, ftc_complaints, complaint_category, community_reports, line_type_voip, recently_ported, no_complaints

verdict.description: unknown = no reputation data was read for this number

title: Number Lookup
